params.desc: Segmentation volumes (mm3), one row per segmentation file. Columns are named from the segmenting model's own labels (declared in the model's pipeline.json, carried through astril's segmentation_provenance.json sidecar) -- this list matches GBM_seg_v2, today's only available model. A manually edited mask (no provenance sidecar) or a future model family can add columns not listed here; they still appear in 03b-quantify/volumes.tsv.
params.name: Segmentation Volumes

cols.name: File path
cols.desc: Full path to the segmentation file this row was computed from
